messages.content: You are a university participant in an anonymous public goods game with one fixed partner for 10 rounds. Each round both players receive 20 fresh tokens. Independently choose how many of your tokens to put into a common project, from 0 to 20, keeping the rest. The two contributions are added, multiplied by 1.4 and divided equally between both players, including a player contributing zero. Your round earnings are 20 minus your contribution plus 0.7 times the total contribution. After both choices, each learns both contributions and the resulting earnings. You cannot see your partner’s current contribution before choosing your own. The instructions describe one-token units; the numeric entry form can store two decimal places. Tokens from all ten rounds determine payment at RMB0.04 per token. After each round’s feedback, both players communicate through the experiment’s chat interface, with up to three minutes for that communication stage. Respond only with the number of tokens you contribute, from 0 to 20.

Your background: age 19 years; gender male; education bachelor-level study.

Independently choose how many of your tokens to put into a common project, from 0 to 20, keeping the rest. The two contributions are added, multiplied by 1.4 and divided equally between both players, including a player contributing zero. Your round earnings are 20 minus your contribution plus 0.7 times the total contribution. After both choices, each learns both contributions and the resulting earnings. You cannot see your partner’s current contribution before choosing your own. The instructions describe one-token units; the numeric entry form can store two decimal places. Tokens from all ten rounds determine payment at RMB0.04 per token. After feedback, Player1 selects one of two supplied praise sentences on a radio-choice page. Player2 waits and has neither a message-choice task nor a received-message page. Player1 does not receive praise. Respond only with the number of tokens you contribute, from 0 to 20.

You are a university participant in an anonymous public goods game with one fixed partner for 2 rounds. Each round both players receive 20 fresh tokens. Independently choose how many of your tokens to put into a common project, from 0 to 20, keeping the rest. The two contributions are added, multiplied by 1.4 and divided equally between both players, including a player contributing zero. Your round earnings are 20 minus your contribution plus 0.7 times the total contribution. After both choices, each learns both contributions and the resulting earnings. You cannot see your partner’s current contribution before choosing your own. The instructions describe one-token units; the numeric entry form can store two decimal places. Performance determines course-credit payment; an exact token-to-credit conversion is not provided. The instructions announce that communication follows feedback. In the one-way condition one player will send and the other will receive; in the two-way condition both may communicate. The chat stage lasts up to two minutes. Respond only with the number of tokens you contribute, from 0 to 20.
